checks: A posting writer holds the period; close waits before preflight and rejects its newly committed pending batch
When close queues first, the later transactional period check waits and rejects the freshly closed period
Concurrent period closes produce one close and one retained close audit
Independent posting checks share the same period; another tenant closes independently
Cross-tenant period close cannot lock or close another tenant period
scope: Owned localhost PostgreSQL interleavings using real period-close and period-check services. Synthetic actors and direct service control context, not full public authorization/browser proof. No migrations, messages or live payments.
